threads.body: [Testing] This assumption now checks preview selection, but its failure message still says stable RPC semconv, so a skipped test reports the wrong requirement. Rename the message to preview RPC semconv.

[General] This rename removes `emitStableServicePeerSemconv()` from the published, stable `instrumentation-api` artifact (`instrumentation-api/gradle.properties:1` sets `otel.stable=true`), so downstream binaries using the existing public method will fail with `NoSuchMethodError`. Keep the old method as a deprecated delegate to `emitPreviewServicePeerSemconv()` until 3.0, with the required deprecation Javadoc and CHANGELOG entry.

This issue also appears on line 118 of the same file.
